name: codex-router
description: Route heavy work from Claude to the Codex CLI by difficulty tier, and show the Claude vs Codex token share of the session.

easy_model.title: Easy tier: Codex model
easy_model.description: Model for mechanical or bulk work.

easy_effort.title: Easy tier: reasoning effort
easy_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (what the model supports).

medium_model.title: Medium tier: Codex model
medium_model.description: Model for spec-driven feature work and moderate refactors.

medium_effort.title: Medium tier: reasoning effort
medium_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (what the model supports).

hard_model.title: Hard tier: Codex model
hard_model.description: Model for large refactors and hard bugs.

reserve_percent.title: Keep this much of the 5-hour limit
reserve_percent.description: Pause Codex while its 5-hour limit has this many percent or less left, so you keep some for your own use. 0 turns the pause off.

hard_effort.title: Hard tier: reasoning effort
hard_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (what the model supports).
